items.title: 6萬人可申請！微軟推自願離職 副總裁也適用
items.title_en: Up to 60,000 Eligible! Microsoft Launches Voluntary Separation Program, Vice Presidents Included
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)周一(26日)宣布，向美國、加拿大、印度及英國部分員工提供自願離職方案，在擴大AI基礎設施投資之際，兼顧資金運用效率。知情人士透露，約6萬名員工具備申請資格，但這不代表實際離職人數，公司也未設定此次方案的目標人數。
新方案適用於內部職級70級以下、含70級的員工，涵蓋範圍最高達副總裁層級。部分行銷、業務及工程團隊未參與，符合資格者須於12月決定是否接受，參加者將於12月31日離職。
微軟人資長Amy Coleman在員工備忘錄中表示，自願離職方案旨在增加組織調整彈性，並讓員工有更多方式規劃下一階段職涯，同時延續今年稍早自願退休計畫的經驗。
微軟4月首度推出自願退休計畫，約7%的美國員工具備資格，適用對象為資深總監及以下層級。公司表示，當時符合資格者中，逾30%選擇參加；此次方案則將適用職級向上擴大。
隨著AI運算需求攀升，微軟持續加碼資料中心，向Anthropic、OpenAI等業者供應雲端服務，也使財務承受壓力。不過，今年第二季，雲端競爭對手Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)均出現負自由現金流，微軟仍維持正值。
持續更新...
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) announced on Monday (the 26th) that it is offering a voluntary separation program to certain employees in the United States, Canada, India and the United Kingdom, balancing capital efficiency as it expands AI infrastructure investment. Sources say roughly 60,000 employees meet the eligibility criteria, but this does not indicate the actual number who will leave, and the company has not set a target headcount for the program.

The new program applies to internal staff at level 70 or below, including level 70, covering positions up to the vice‑president tier. Some marketing, sales and engineering teams are excluded. Eligible employees must decide by December whether to accept, and participants will depart on December 31.

Microsoft’s chief human‑resources officer Amy Coleman wrote in an employee memo that the voluntary separation program is intended to increase organizational flexibility and give staff more options for planning the next stage of their careers, building on the experience of the voluntary retirement plan launched earlier this year.

Microsoft first introduced a voluntary retirement plan in April, with about 7% of U.S. staff eligible, targeting senior directors and below. The company said that more than 30% of those who qualified chose to participate; the current program expands eligibility to higher levels.

As demand for AI computing rises, Microsoft continues to expand data centers and provide cloud services to firms such as Anthropic and OpenAI, adding financial pressure. Nevertheless, in the second quarter of this year, cloud rivals Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) both reported negative free cash flow, while Microsoft remained in the positive.
Updates will follow.

items.title: 通膨升溫為何不升息？Fed傳聲筒揭本周料按兵不動原因
items.title_en: Why Rising Inflation Doesn’t Lead to a Rate Hike? Fed Spokesperson Explains This Week’s Expected Hold
paras: 《華爾街日報》記者、有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的Nick Timiraos周一(26日)撰文指出，儘管最新通膨數據增強再次升息的理由，聯準會(Fed)本周仍預料將按兵不動。原因除了經濟情勢，也與官員先前釋出的耐心觀望訊號有關：市場已降低本月升息預期，若此時突然出手，將在美國期中選舉前不到一周製造政策意外。
Fed上月升息後，多位高階官員表示不必急於再次行動，但隨後公布的9月消費者與生產者物價數據均高於預期。這使Fed偏好的通膨指標朝2%目標回落的進展，可能延續自2025年初以來的停滯局面，也讓決策官員陷入溝通訊號與經濟數據不完全一致的處境。

通膨升溫仍未改口 華許讓暫停預期站穩

Fed主席華許在10月16日、決策會議前緘默期開始前夕發表談話時，並未提及最新通膨報告，而是表示經濟表現「大致符合」官員9月開會時的預期。這番說法未改變市場對暫停升息的判斷，本月升息機率隨後降至約15%。
前達拉斯聯準銀行總裁、現任高盛(GS-US)副董事長Robert Kaplan表示，若Fed打算10月升息，事前就需要做更多溝通鋪陳；按照目前情勢，阻力最小的選擇就是維持利率不變。
Fed官員堅稱，政治不會影響決策。曾在Fed體系任職逾十年的巴克萊美國首席經濟學家Marc Giannoni也認同，但他指出，選舉前幾天，官員會希望避免成為新聞焦點。考量Fed已塑造的市場預期，這也支持本周按兵不動。
不過，部分經濟學家認為，既然市場普遍預期12月還會升息，等待六周的好處有限，反而可能讓Fed落後於情勢，之後被迫加快步調。前Fed經濟學家Claudia Sahm表示，單從風險管理與數據判斷，Fed本周就有理由升息。

等待六周仍有理由 連續升息恐誤導市場

支持等待的官員也有經濟上的考量。多數決策官員在9月預測中，僅預期今年還需再升息一次；若認為利率不必大幅上調，拉開行動間隔，就能爭取更多時間觀察趨勢。
Kaplan認為，戰略錯誤與戰術錯誤有所不同，晚六周行動是可控的風險。瑞銀(UBS-US)美國首席經濟學家Jonathan Pingle則指出，連續兩次會議升息，可能讓投資人誤以為Fed準備展開比官員實際規劃更快的緊縮循環。
Pingle表示，當前情況不同於2022年，通膨並未失控，而是停滯在約3%的水準。
債市劇烈波動也支持審慎行事。美國10年期公債殖利率在9月升息後突破5%，隨後三周一度升破5.3%，創24年新高；但上周四科技股遭拋售，資金轉向公債避險，殖利率單日下跌19個基點至4.95%，創2023年3月矽谷銀行倒閉以來最大單日跌幅。
Kaplan指出，製造不必要的市場波動也有代價，決策官員必須納入考量。

官員對緊縮幅度存分歧 12月與明年升息仍受關注

Fed內部真正的分歧，在於利率究竟還需要升高多少。紐約聯準銀行總裁John Williams與舊金山聯準銀行總裁Mary Daly將9月升息視為風險管理，目的是防止通膨根深蒂固，而非認為利率已嚴重偏離適當水準。
Daly本月稍早仍認為，Fed存在不必再升息的可能性，但在消費者物價報告公布後，她改稱，後續升息的可能性已高於不升息。
另一派官員則希望利率能積極抑制經濟。達拉斯聯準銀行總裁Lorie Logan主張，至少還需升息半個百分點；克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁Beth Hammack則支持較快進行小幅調整，避免拖延後必須大幅修正政策。
Logan、Hammack與明尼亞波利斯聯準銀行總裁Neel Kashkari曾在7月反對維持利率不變、支持升息，若本周三再度按兵不動，可能再次出現異議票。Fed理事Christopher Waller則採取折衷立場，認為不必每次會議都升息，但應在合理時間內完成必要調整。
Fed目前基準利率區間為3.75%至4%。若本周維持不變，焦點將轉向華許如何在記者會解釋決策，以及是否為12月升息預作鋪陳。9月通膨數據公布後，包括Giannoni在內的部分分析師，已將明年初再升息一次納入預測。
Fed面臨的難題是，AI投資熱潮正碰上供給限制，包括美伊戰爭帶來的衝擊，而升息無法直接解決這些問題。當前物價壓力也不完全符合傳統上勞動市場緊俏、薪資上漲所帶動的全面經濟過熱。
Giannoni認為，風險偏向需要更多升息。若AI建設持續擴張，資源吃緊進一步推升更廣泛的物價，Fed可能必須採取更多行動，才能讓經濟降溫。
paras_en: Wall Street Journal reporter Nick Timiraos, known as the “Fed’s spokesperson,” wrote on Monday (the 26th) that despite the latest inflation data strengthening the case for another rate hike, the Federal Reserve is still expected to hold steady this week. The reasoning includes not only economic conditions but also the patience signals previously given by officials: the market has lowered its expectations for a rate increase this month, and a sudden move now would create a policy surprise less than a week before the U.S. midterm elections.

After the Fed’s rate hike last month, several senior officials said there was no need to act again quickly, yet the September consumer‑price and producer‑price data that followed both came in above expectations. This makes progress toward the Fed’s 2% inflation target look stalled since early 2025 and puts policymakers in a situation where their communication signals do not fully align with the economic data.

Inflation’s rise has not changed the Fed chair’s stance, keeping the pause expectation firm. When Fed Chair Jerome Powell spoke on October 16, just before the pre‑meeting mute period, he did not mention the latest inflation report, instead saying the economy is “roughly in line” with what officials expected in September. That comment did not shift the market’s view that a pause is likely, and the probability of a hike this month subsequently fell to about 15%.

Former Dallas Fed president and current Goldman Sachs vice chairman Robert Kaplan said that if the Fed intends to raise rates in October, it would need to do more pre‑emptive communication; given the current situation, the least resistant option is to keep rates unchanged.

Fed officials insist politics will not affect decisions. Barclays U.S. chief economist Marc Giannoni, who spent more than a decade in the Fed system, agrees but notes that in the days leading up to an election officials want to avoid becoming a news focus. Considering the market expectations the Fed has already shaped, this also supports a hold this week.

However, some economists argue that since the market broadly expects a December hike, waiting six weeks offers limited benefit and could leave the Fed lagging behind the situation, forcing a faster pace later. Former Fed economist Claudia Sahm said that purely from a risk‑management and data‑assessment perspective, the Fed has reason to hike this week.

There are economic reasons for waiting, too. Most policymakers in September forecast only one more hike this year; if they believe rates do not need a large increase, spacing out actions gives them more time to observe trends.

Kaplan believes strategic errors differ from tactical ones, and a six‑week delay is a controllable risk. UBS chief U.S. economist Jonathan Pingle warned that raising rates in two consecutive meetings could mislead investors into thinking the Fed is prepared to embark on a tighter cycle faster than officials actually plan.
Pingle added that the current situation differs from 2022: inflation is not out of control but has stalled around the 3% level.

Bond‑market volatility also supports a cautious approach. After the September hike, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield broke above 5%, later peaking at 5.3% for three weeks – a 24‑year high – but last Thursday a tech‑stock sell‑off shifted funds to safe‑haven Treasuries, pulling the yield down 19 basis points to 4.95%, the biggest single‑day drop since Silicon Valley Bank’s collapse in March 2023.
Kaplan noted that creating unnecessary market turbulence has costs, and policymakers must factor that in.

Officials are divided on how much tightening is still needed, and that is the real split inside the Fed. New York Fed president John Williams and San Francisco Fed president Mary Daly view the September hike as risk management to prevent entrenched inflation, not as evidence that rates are far from appropriate levels.
Daly earlier this month still thought a further hike might not be necessary, but after the consumer‑price report she said the odds of another hike now exceed the odds of holding steady.

Another camp wants rates to actively curb the economy. Dallas Fed president Lorie Logan argues at least another half‑point hike is needed; Cleveland Fed president Beth Hammack favors a quicker, modest adjustment to avoid a delayed, larger correction later.

Logan, Hammack and Minneapolis Fed president Neel Kashkari opposed a hold and backed a hike in July; if they again vote to hold this Wednesday, dissent votes could reappear. Fed governor Christopher Waller takes a middle‑ground view, saying a hike isn’t required at every meeting but necessary adjustments should be made within a reasonable timeframe.

The Fed’s target range is currently 3.75%‑4%. If rates stay unchanged this week, attention will shift to how Powell explains the decision at the press conference and whether he is laying groundwork for a December hike. After September’s inflation data, some analysts, including Giannoni, have already factored in a possible early‑next‑year hike.

The Fed’s dilemma is that an AI investment boom is colliding with supply constraints, including shocks from the U.S.–Iran conflict, and rate hikes cannot directly solve those issues. Current price pressures also do not fully match the traditional picture of an overheating economy driven by a tight labor market and rising wages.

Giannoni believes the risk tilt calls for more hikes. If AI construction continues to expand, resource tightness could push broader price increases, and the Fed may need to act further to cool the economy.

items.title: 歷史首次！中國車廠在歐洲季度銷量超過日本
items.title_en: Historic First! Chinese Car Makers Surpass Japan in European Quarterly Sales
paras: 在一個完整季度內，中國汽車製造商在歐洲的銷量首次超過日本競爭對手，凸顯出比亞迪(002594-CN) 、奇瑞等中國品牌在歐洲市場擴大市佔率的速度。
據《彭博》26日（周一）報導，市場研究機構Dataforce的數據，在今年7至9月，中國品牌汽車的掛牌量較去年同期增長約一倍，佔歐洲汽車總銷量12.7%，其中混合動力汽車表現尤為強勁。這一比重已超過日本汽車製造商的11.9%。
中國汽車銷量的增長勢頭在第三季末進一步加快。Dataforce的數據顯示，9月中國品牌在歐洲的市佔率升至14.5%，刷新歷史紀錄，並較8月高出近3個百分點。
儘管福斯汽車、雷諾集團等歐洲製造商仍主導該地區市場，但中國品牌崛起的速度令人意外。五年前，中國品牌佔歐洲銷量的比重僅約1%。
相比之下，日本汽車製造商用了數十年時間才在歐洲站穩腳跟。
歐盟正在考慮提出新規，在發放補貼及其他激勵措施時優先支持本地生產的汽車。同時，中國汽車製造商已開始為在歐洲本地生產做準備。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: In a full quarter, Chinese automobile manufacturers outpaced their Japanese rivals in Europe for the first time, highlighting the rapid market‑share gains of Chinese brands such as BYD (002594-CN) and Chery in the region.

According to Bloomberg on Monday the 26th, market‑research firm Dataforce reported that from July to September this year, the registrations of Chinese‑brand cars in Europe were about double those of the same period last year, accounting for 12.7% of total European car sales, with hybrid vehicles performing especially strongly. This share has now overtaken Japanese manufacturers’ 11.9%.

The growth momentum of Chinese car sales accelerated further at the end of the third quarter. Dataforce’s data show that in September Chinese brands’ market share in Europe rose to 14.5%, a historic high and nearly three percentage points higher than in August.

Although European manufacturers such as Volkswagen and the Renault Group still dominate the regional market, the speed of the Chinese brands’ rise is surprising. Five years ago, Chinese brands accounted for only about 1% of European sales.
By contrast, Japanese automakers took several decades to firmly establish themselves in Europe.

The EU is considering new regulations that would give priority to locally produced vehicles when granting subsidies and other incentives. At the same time, Chinese car makers have already begun preparing for local production in Europe.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 看好Claude也不急著買！華爾街為Anthropic上市算三筆帳
items.title_en: Optimistic About Claude Yet Not Rushing to Buy! Wall Street Counts Three Angles on Anthropic's IPO
paras: Anthropic公開上市申請文件，為AI投資熱潮帶來新的信心測試。華爾街投資人士認為，這場IPO將成為頂尖AI模型開發商的估值指標，但看好技術前景，不代表願意在上市時買進。估值是否合理、巨額募資會否排擠其他科技股資金，以及企業需求能否支撐長期投入，正成為市場關注焦點。
Anthropic遞件消息一度提振美股期指，標普500指數周一(26日)早盤上漲0.5%。不過，受訪人士對上市後的表現看法分歧，有人視為AI行情仍具活力的證明，也有人認為，投資人日後可能等到更好的進場價格。

看好AI不等於追IPO 投資人不願再開空白支票

Cresalta Investment Management投資長Josh Stevens表示，他對AI技術抱持樂觀，也認為Anthropic令人期待，但不會急著在IPO時買進。即使是優秀的構想或商業模式，在市場重新評估供需時，股價仍可能回落至更具吸引力的水準，屆時才是進場機會。
Great Hill Capital董事長Thomas Hayes則認為，約1.5兆美元的估值偏高，這場發行更適合深信公司終將帶來投資回報的人。他指出，短期股價可能因發行股票供給受控而上漲，但長期仍須由經營成果支撐，在公司扭轉虧損之前，投資人可能有機會以低於IPO的價格買進。
Hayes對估值的質疑部分建立在巨額淨損之上。不過，依先前揭露的財務資料，Anthropic上半年807億美元淨損主要受到可轉換債券公允價值上升影響，同期營業虧損為6.93億美元，不能將淨損直接視為營運現金消耗。
Renaissance Capital資深策略師Matt Kennedy表示，幾個月前，投資人還不會如此嚴格質疑估值，如今部分夏季熱門AI新股已跌破發行價，即使是Anthropic，也拿不到市場的「空白支票」。

與Meta募資同場競逐 小型AI股恐受資金排擠

除了定價，Anthropic上市也可能牽動既有科技股的資金流向。Hayes指出，若投資人賣出科技七巨頭中的大型雲端業者股票，籌錢參與Anthropic IPO，未來幾周可能對這些股票構成壓力。
他認為，影響程度將取決於微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)本周財報表現，這些公司的業績與展望，將左右投資人是否繼續持有，或轉而布局新上市的AI公司。
Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry則提醒，Meta(META-US)也宣布計劃透過股權發行籌資最多950億美元，兩大募資案可能同時吸收大量市場資金。
Mulberry認為，當大型業者競相籌資，規模較小、甚至品質較差的AI公司可能受到不利影響。Anthropic上市即使成功，也不代表資金會平均流向整個AI產業。
IPOX Schuster分析師Lukas Muehlbauer同樣指出，投資人仍會區分已有客戶需求驗證的業務，以及主要依賴未來成長預期支撐的支出計畫，因此這場IPO的好處不會由所有AI企業平等分享。

上市成敗牽動產業信心 AI估值將有新標竿

Andersen Capital Management創辦人Peter Andersen認為，Anthropic上市是AI發展的重要里程碑，結果將反映投資人是否願意繼續支持AI開發所需的資本支出。
Muehlbauer則表示，這場IPO將為領先AI實驗室建立估值標竿，影響後續上市案，也牽動市場對資助AI基礎設施建設企業的信心。
Ingenium Analytics管理合夥人Andre Bakhos較為樂觀，認為此案顯示AI交易熱潮仍有活力，AI應用滲透將持續，也有助提振同業投資情緒。不過，他強調，這也是一場資金競賽，估值與成長能持續多久的問題不會消失。
Dakota Wealth資深投資組合經理Robert Pavlik則認為，上市環境充滿挑戰，成敗不僅關係Anthropic，也牽動整個AI產業。若發行順利，可能重建投資人信心，但公司需要提出足以吸引市場的承諾，而這些承諾能否在短期內兌現，仍有疑問。
Kennedy另指出，上市對Anthropic也有策略意義。公司採公益公司(PBC)架構，成為上市公司將帶來更高程度的公開透明度，讓市場能持續檢視其營運與財務表現。
paras_en: Anthropic has filed its IPO registration, providing a new confidence test amid the AI investment boom. Wall Street investors see the offering as a valuation benchmark for top AI model developers, but liking the technology’s prospects does not mean they are willing to buy at the listing. Questions about whether the valuation is reasonable, whether the massive fundraising will crowd out other tech stocks, and whether corporate demand can sustain long‑term investment are becoming market focal points.

Anthropic’s filing briefly lifted U.S. equity futures, with the S&P 500 up 0.5% in early trade on Monday the 26th. Yet interviewees are split on post‑IPO performance: some view it as proof that AI momentum remains strong, while others think investors may wait for a better entry price later.

Being bullish on AI does not equal chasing the IPO; investors are unwilling to write blank checks. Josh Stevens, CIO of Cresalta Investment Management, said he is optimistic about AI and finds Anthropic exciting, but he won’t rush to buy at the IPO. Even a great idea or business model can see its stock fall back to a more attractive level when the market re‑evaluates supply and demand, and that would be the real entry point.

Thomas Hayes, chairman of Great Hill Capital, believes a roughly $1.5 trillion valuation is too high and the offering suits those who are convinced the company will eventually deliver returns. He noted that short‑term share price may rise because the stock supply is controlled, but long‑term performance must be backed by operating results, and investors could have a chance to buy below the IPO price before the company turns profitable.

Hayes’s valuation concerns stem partly from the huge net loss. However, according to previously disclosed financials, Anthropic’s H1 net loss of $80.7 billion was mainly driven by a rise in the fair value of convertible bonds, while operating loss for the period was $693 million, so the net loss should not be taken as a direct cash‑burn indicator.

Matt Kennedy, senior strategist at Renaissance Capital, said that a few months ago investors would not have scrutinized the valuation so tightly. Now several summer‑hot AI IPOs have already fallen below their issue prices, and even Anthropic cannot expect a market “blank check.”

Competing with Meta for fundraising, small AI stocks may be squeezed. In addition to pricing, Anthropic’s listing could shift capital away from existing tech stocks. Hayes pointed out that if investors sell shares of the big seven tech cloud players to fund the Anthropic IPO, those stocks could feel pressure in the coming weeks.

He added that the impact will depend on this week’s earnings from Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US). Those companies’ results and outlooks will dictate whether investors stay put or reallocate to the newly listed AI firm.

Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, warned that Meta (META‑US) also announced plans to raise up to $95 billion through an equity offering, meaning the two large fundraising efforts could soak up a lot of market capital at the same time.

Mulberry argued that when big players race to raise money, smaller or lower‑quality AI companies may suffer. Even if Anthropic’s IPO succeeds, it does not guarantee that capital will flow evenly across the AI sector.

Lukas Muehlbauer, analyst at IPOX Schuster, likewise noted that investors will still differentiate between businesses with verified customer demand and those whose spending plans rely mainly on future growth expectations, so the benefits of this IPO will not be shared equally by all AI firms.

The IPO’s success or failure will affect industry confidence, creating a new benchmark for AI valuations. Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management, said Anthropic’s listing is a key milestone for AI development, and the outcome will reflect whether investors are willing to keep funding the capital‑intensive AI pipeline.
Muehlbauer added that the offering will set a valuation benchmark for leading AI labs, influencing subsequent listings and shaping market confidence in funding AI infrastructure companies.

Andre Bakhos, managing partner at Ingenium Analytics, is relatively upbeat, seeing the deal as evidence that AI trading enthusiasm remains strong, that AI adoption will continue, and that it could boost peer investment sentiment. He cautioned, however, that this is also a capital race, and questions about how long valuations and growth can be sustained will not disappear.

Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth, said the listing environment is challenging and the outcome matters not only for Anthropic but for the whole AI industry. A smooth offering could rebuild investor confidence, but the company must make market‑appealing commitments, and there is doubt whether those promises can be delivered in the short term.

Kennedy also pointed out that the IPO has strategic significance for Anthropic. The company’s public‑benefit corporation (PBC) structure means that becoming a listed company will increase transparency, allowing the market to continuously monitor its operations and financial performance.

items.title: iPad mini終於換OLED！首度支援防水 台灣售價22900元起
items.title_en: iPad mini finally gets OLED! First to support water resistance, Taiwan price from NT$22,900
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周一(26日)發表全新iPad mini，搭載OLED螢幕、A20 Pro晶片與防水設計，美國售價699美元起，揭開本周新品連發序幕。新機在美國於周三(28日)開放預購，11月6日上市，提供午夜色與星光色。
台灣市場將於周四(29日)凌晨1時10分開放預購，11月6日正式開賣，售價新台幣22,900元起。
新款iPad mini透過縮窄邊框，將螢幕由8.3吋放大至8.5吋。OLED面板可呈現更深邃的黑色、更明亮的白色與更佳對比，另提供標準及奈米紋理霧面玻璃選項。
蘋果也導入「Acoustic Display」音訊系統，將揚聲器置於螢幕下方，協助新機成為首款具備IP67防塵防水等級的iPad。機身較前代薄14%、輕13%，前置相機位置也經調整，更適合FaceTime與視訊會議。
效能方面，新機由前代A17 Pro升級至A20 Pro，提供128GB、256GB與512GB容量。起價較前代599美元提高100美元，若選擇最大容量、奈米紋理霧面螢幕及行動網路版本，售價最高達1,249美元。
不同容量的晶片規格也有差異：128GB與256GB版本配備5核心CPU，高階版本則為6核心CPU，兩者均搭載7核心GPU。高階版本另具雙16核心神經網路引擎，強化AI處理能力。
連線功能則採用蘋果N1晶片，支援Wi-Fi 7與藍牙6，行動網路機型另搭載自家C2數據機。
蘋果本周稍晚還計劃推出新款iMac與搭載M6晶片的14吋MacBook Pro，並以首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro壓軸。公司周三將在洛杉磯舉行發表活動，讓媒體與內容創作者體驗新品。
這波更新接續上周五首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo上市，為蘋果今年密集的新品布局收尾。有外媒指出，蘋果正開發入門款iPad、OLED版iPad Air及更新版iPad Pro，預計明年上半年推出。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) announced the new iPad mini on Monday (the 26th), featuring an OLED display, A20 Pro chip and water‑resistant design, with a U.S. starting price of $699, kicking off a week of product launches. The device opened for pre‑order in the United States on Wednesday (the 28th) and will be available on November 6, offered in Midnight and Starlight colors.
In Taiwan, pre‑orders will begin on Thursday (the 29th) at 1:10 a.m., with sales starting on November 6 and a starting price of NT$22,900.

The new iPad mini expands the screen from 8.3 inches to 8.5 inches by narrowing the bezels. The OLED panel delivers deeper blacks, brighter whites and higher contrast, and is available with either standard glass or a nano‑textured matte glass option.

Apple also introduces an “Acoustic Display” audio system that places the speakers beneath the screen, making this the first iPad with an IP67 dust‑and‑water resistance rating. The body is 14 % thinner and 13 % lighter than the previous generation, and the front‑camera position has been adjusted for better FaceTime and video‑conference use.

In terms of performance, the device upgrades from the previous A17 Pro to the A20 Pro and comes in 128 GB, 256 GB and 512 GB storage options. The base price is $100 higher than the prior model’s $599, and the top‑end configuration—512 GB, nano‑textured matte display and cellular model—reaches $1,249.

Chip specifications vary by storage: the 128 GB and 256 GB models feature a 5‑core CPU, while the high‑end version uses a 6‑core CPU; both have a 7‑core GPU. The high‑end model also includes dual 16‑core Neural Engine units for enhanced AI processing.
Connectivity is handled by Apple’s N1 chip, supporting Wi‑Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, while the cellular variant adds Apple’s own C2 modem.

Apple also plans to unveil a new iMac and a 14‑inch MacBook Pro powered by the M6 chip later this week, with the first touch‑screen MacBook Pro as the headline product. The company will hold a launch event in Los Angeles on Wednesday for media and content creators to experience the new devices.

This wave of updates follows last Friday’s launch of the first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, rounding out Apple’s intensive product rollout for the year. Foreign media report that Apple is developing an entry‑level iPad, an OLED iPad Air and an updated iPad Pro, expected to arrive in the first half of next year.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉中釉憑轉型新材料事業力拚轉機 周漲12.44%站回所有均線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Zhongyou (1809-TW) Pursues Turnaround via New Materials Business, Rises 12.44% This Week and Reclaims All Moving Averages
paras: 中釉(1809-TW)近年積極轉型，旗下新材料事業中的螢光玻璃片新品效益持續擴大，成為營運助力，大盤上周跌破5日線，中釉卻在成交量爆量衝上5.1萬張挹注下，周漲12.44%，股價收47元，站上所有均線，周K收紅。
中釉產品線近年因AI崛起，新產品布局積極，由傳統磁磚與釉料製造持續轉型為新材料，今(2026)年從玻璃與陶瓷專業技術出發，除了跨足半導體關鍵材料領域，也在類晶玻璃陶瓷基板技術上取得突破性進展。
法人表示，中釉近年除了轉型研發高附加價值的「螢光玻璃片」與「電子陶瓷材料」，也成功打入LED與車用光電封裝應用，投入固態電池電解質隔離膜材料，讓轉型題材也成為市場追逐熱點。
在營運層面上，中釉上(9)月營收年增5.88%、月增 7.68%，單月營收創近 8 個月新高，近期訂單動能有穩定成長跡象，投資人後續可關注中釉在汽車螢光玻璃片、陶瓷基板與半導體材料等新產品線的放量進度，以及營收能否延續穩定年增與高階材料占比提升。
中釉目前旗下有三大事業，包括陶瓷事業部、建築材料事業部、新材料事業部；其中最受矚的是新材料事業，包括螢光玻璃片、低介電類晶玻璃陶瓷基板、固態電池用電解質隔離膜材料等三大產品線。
paras_en: Zhongyou (1809‑TW) has been actively transforming in recent years, and the new fluorescent glass sheet product in its new‑materials division continues to expand its benefits, becoming an operational boost. While the broader market fell below the 5‑day moving average last week, Zhongyou surged on a massive volume of 51,000 shares, gaining 12.44% for the week and closing at NT$47, above all moving averages, with a red weekly candlestick.

In recent years, driven by the rise of AI, Zhongyou’s product strategy has shifted aggressively from traditional tiles and glazes toward new materials. Starting in 2026, leveraging its glass and ceramic expertise, the company not only entered the semiconductor key‑materials arena but also achieved breakthrough progress in quasi‑crystalline glass‑ceramic substrate technology.

Institutional investors note that Zhongyou has, beyond developing high‑value‑added “fluorescent glass sheets” and “electronic ceramic materials,” successfully entered LED and automotive optoelectronic packaging markets, and is investing in solid‑state battery electrolyte separator materials, turning its transformation theme into a market‑hot topic.

On the operational side, Zhongyou’s revenue in September rose 5.88% year‑over‑year and 7.68% month‑over‑month, setting a near‑eight‑month high for a single month. Recent order flow shows steady growth, and investors can watch the scaling of new product lines such as automotive fluorescent glass sheets, ceramic substrates, and semiconductor materials, as well as whether revenue can maintain stable year‑over‑year growth and an increasing share of high‑end materials.

Zhongyou currently operates three major divisions: the Ceramic Division, the Building Materials Division, and the New Materials Division. The most watched is the New Materials Division, which includes three product lines: fluorescent glass sheets, low‑dielectric quasi‑crystalline glass‑ceramic substrates, and electrolyte separator membranes for solid‑state batteries.

items.title: 算力沒用也得付錢！Anthropic上市文件揭長期支出壓力
items.title_en: You Still Have to Pay for Unused Compute! Anthropic's IPO Filing Reveals Long‑Term Spending Pressure
paras: 根據《路透》周一(26日)報導，Claude開發商Anthropic的上市文件揭露，公司已向六家合作夥伴承諾，未來十年支出逾5,000億美元，且許多合約條款不得取消，或要求不論實際使用量都須付款。這些長期義務凸顯，Anthropic衝刺AI技術領先地位之際，也必須持續取得資金，支應龐大的算力與基礎設施需求。
其中，亞馬遜與Google不僅是Anthropic的重要股東，也是提供模型訓練與運作所需算力的供應商。科技巨頭一方面投入資金，另一方面透過雲端服務取得收入，讓AI產業日益緊密的資金循環成為市場檢視焦點。

十年支出承諾逾5,000億美元 部分費用不隨用量減少

算力是Anthropic最大的費用來源，相關支出涵蓋支付雲端業者的運算費、資料中心設施與容量租金、設備租賃及能源帳單。路透指出，過去三年，公司算力與基礎設施費用遠高於營收。
Anthropic預期，這類費用的絕對金額將繼續增加，在可預見的未來仍是最大營運費用。為確保模型開發與服務所需資源，公司已與六家夥伴簽下十年合計逾5,000億美元的支出承諾，規模居AI基礎設施建設計畫前列。
已揭露的項目包括，未來七至十年向亞馬遜(AMZN-US)採購至少1,100億美元的雲端服務、向Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)支付約1,145億美元，以及向微軟(MSFT-US)支付449億美元。這些金額屬於整體支出承諾的一部分。
值得關注的是，許多協議包含不得取消的條款，或要求不論實際使用量都必須付款。這意味著，若需求成長不如預期，公司未必能透過減少算力使用，同步降低相關付款負擔。

股東也是供應商 AI資金循環牽動成長

亞馬遜已向Anthropic投資至少130億美元，並同意再投資最多200億美元；Google則承諾投資最多400億美元。兩家公司同時提供支撐Claude訓練與部署的雲端基礎設施。
路透指出，這是AI產業循環融資結構的另一例：大型科技公司投資AI開發商，開發商再向這些投資人購買算力與雲端服務，使股權投資與業務收入彼此連結。
Anthropic的收入則主要來自企業客戶按使用量付費，以處理的Token數量計價，另有Pro、Max等付費訂閱方案。公司早期著重程式設計能力，協助其吸引企業客戶，並在AI競爭中取得優勢。
營收由2023年的4,100萬美元，增至2024年的3.86億美元及2025年的45.9億美元；今年上半年已達162.9億美元。第二季營收更較去年同期大增1,368%，顯示企業採用AI服務的需求快速擴張。
不過，Anthropic也在文件中提醒，營收與應收帳款集中於有限數量的客戶及分銷管道，業務成長仍面臨集中度風險。

807億美元淨損須分辨 估值與資金需求面臨檢驗

龐大支出之外，Anthropic上半年807億美元淨損也受到關注，但這項數字不能直接視為營運現金消耗。路透指出，淨損大幅擴大，主要受到可轉換為公司股票的債券公允價值上升影響。
相較之下，公司今年上半年營業虧損為6.93億美元；2025年全年營業虧損為80.6億美元，2024年則為29.8億美元。淨損與營業虧損反映不同層面的財務結果，評估AI業務成本時須加以區分。
Anthropic正尋求透過IPO取得資金，支應昂貴的模型開發與營運需求，但市場對AI投資回報的疑慮也正在升高。投資人擔心，投入資料中心、晶片與算力的數兆美元，能否及時產生足夠回報，支撐高估值。
《路透》先前報導，在Anthropic近期向投資人揭露部分財務資料後，一些現有與潛在投資人給予公司的估值約為1.5兆美元，低於一周前的約2兆美元。這並非已確定的IPO定價，卻反映市場正重新衡量其高速成長、長期付款義務與資金需求。
paras_en: According to Reuters on Monday (the 26th), Anthropic’s IPO filing disclosed that the company has pledged to spend over $500 billion over the next ten years with six partners, and many contract terms cannot be cancelled or require payment regardless of actual usage. These long‑term obligations highlight that while Anthropic races to lead in AI technology, it must continuously raise capital to cover massive compute and infrastructure needs.

Amazon and Google are not only major shareholders of Anthropic but also suppliers of the compute power needed for model training and operation. The tech giants invest capital while earning revenue through cloud services, making the increasingly tight cash‑flow loop in the AI industry a focal point for market observers.

The $500 billion ten‑year spending commitment includes costs that do not shrink with usage. Compute is Anthropic’s biggest expense, covering cloud provider fees, data‑center facilities and capacity rentals, equipment leasing and energy bills. Reuters noted that over the past three years the company’s compute and infrastructure costs far exceeded its revenue.

Anthropic expects the absolute amount of these costs to keep rising and to remain its largest operating expense in the foreseeable future. To secure the resources needed for model development and services, the company has signed ten‑year contracts with six partners totaling more than $500 billion, placing the plan among the largest AI‑infrastructure projects.

Disclosed items include a commitment to purchase at least $110 billion of cloud services from Amazon (AMZN‑US) over the next seven to ten years, about $114.5 billion to Alphabet, Google’s parent (GOOGL‑US), and $44.9 billion to Microsoft (MSFT‑US). These amounts are part of the overall spending commitment.

Many agreements contain non‑cancellation clauses or require payment regardless of actual usage. This means that if demand grows slower than expected, the company cannot simply cut compute usage to reduce its payment burden.

Shareholders are also suppliers, tying AI cash flow to growth. Amazon has invested at least $13 billion in Anthropic and agreed to invest up to an additional $20 billion; Google has pledged up to $40 billion. Both companies provide the cloud infrastructure that supports Claude’s training and deployment.

Reuters said this illustrates another facet of the AI industry’s circular financing: large tech firms invest in AI developers, who in turn buy compute and cloud services from those investors, linking equity stakes with business revenue.

Anthropic’s revenue mainly comes from enterprise customers paying per usage, priced by the number of tokens processed, along with paid subscription plans such as Pro and Max. The company’s early focus on programming capabilities helped attract enterprise clients and gain an edge in the AI race.

Revenue grew from $41 million in 2023 to $386 million in 2024 and $4.59 billion in 2025, reaching $16.29 billion in the first half of this year. Second‑quarter revenue jumped 1,368% year‑over‑year, showing rapid expansion of corporate AI‑service demand.

However, Anthropic warned in the filing that its revenue and accounts receivable are concentrated among a limited number of customers and distribution channels, leaving growth exposed to concentration risk.

A net loss of $80.7 billion in the first half of the year has drawn attention, but Reuters cautioned that this figure should not be taken as cash burn. The loss surged mainly due to the fair‑value increase of convertible bonds that can be turned into company stock.

By contrast, operating loss for the first half of the year was $693 million; full‑year operating loss is projected at $8.06 billion for 2025 and $2.98 billion for 2024. Net loss and operating loss reflect different financial dimensions and must be distinguished when assessing AI‑business costs.

Anthropic is seeking to raise funds through an IPO to cover costly model development and operating needs, but investor doubts about AI investment returns are rising. Investors worry whether the trillions of dollars poured into data centers, chips and compute will generate sufficient returns in time to justify lofty valuations.

Reuters previously reported that after Anthropic disclosed some financial data to investors, existing and potential investors valued the company at about $1.5 trillion, down from roughly $2 trillion a week earlier. This is not a set IPO price but shows the market is re‑evaluating its rapid growth, long‑term payment obligations and capital needs.

items.title: 多家機構示警美股風險！貝萊德降至中性、AI仍獲看好、美銀警告估值偏高
items.title_en: Multiple Firms Warn of US Stock Risks: BlackRock Turns Neutral, AI Still Favored, BofA Flags High Valuations
paras: 美股10月走勢轉趨震盪，市場焦點也從股價與估值持續攀升，轉向企業獲利能否支撐高檔行情。隨著美債長期殖利率維持高位、油價反彈加深通膨疑慮，加上避險基金減持人工智慧（AI）科技股，市場多空分歧擴大，華爾街機構對後市的看法也日益分化。
10月初，標普500指數與那斯達克指數一度改寫歷史新高，但隨後獲利了結賣壓升溫，市場波動加大。
10月23日，美股三大指數同步收低，道瓊工業指數下跌1.24%，那斯達克指數下跌0.21%，標普500指數下跌0.52%。以當週表現來看，道瓊上漲0.41%，那斯達克與標普500則分別下跌0.71%及0.47%。
美國銀行(BAC-US) 近期發布策略報告，對美股風險提出警告，並建議降低美股曝險、增加防禦型資產與高收益債券配置。
該行雖給予標普500指數年底目標7400點，但認為美股估值已高，加上長天期美債殖利率居高不下，進一步推升估值的空間有限，企業獲利預期也已反映在股價之中。一旦財報表現不如預期，市場可能面臨估值修正壓力。
美銀也提醒，油價上漲可能再次推高通膨，壓縮聯準會降息空間，甚至增加重新升息的可能性。
儘管避險基金近期減持科技股，使市場交易擁擠程度有所緩解，但投資人情緒仍相對脆弱，AI類股短期交易風險不容忽視。

貝萊德調降美股配置　仍看好AI基礎建設

貝萊德(BLK-US) 也從戰術配置角度，將美股評級由「加碼」下調至「中性」，但並未因此改變對AI產業長期前景的看法。
貝萊德認為，AI基礎建設仍是支撐美股企業獲利的長期動能。不過，在利率偏高、美國政府融資壓力增加的環境下，投資人需要更審慎地挑選標的。融資成本上升將加劇企業表現分化，只有資本報酬能持續高於融資成本的公司，才較有機會維持領先。
在資產配置上，貝萊德選擇適度降低美股部位、增加短天期美國公債配置；至於美股內部，則持續看好AI產業的關鍵瓶頸環節，包括晶片、資料中心、電力基礎建設，以及上市基礎建設類資產。
景順（Invesco）首席全球市場策略師Brian Levitt則認為，美股這波長期漲勢可能已經放緩，但尚未走到終點。
他提醒，市場週期接近尾聲時，往往會出現一系列警訊，包括債務擴張過快、通膨偏高、貨幣政策過度緊縮、信用利差擴大，以及週期性類股遭到拋售等。近期市場變化已出現其中一些特徵，投資人不應掉以輕心。
Levitt特別關注AI基礎建設對債務融資的依賴程度。他指出，債券市場開始更嚴格區分不同借款人的信用品質，自6月以來，信用利差擴大約占高收益債券融資成本升幅的一半，顯示融資成本上升不再只是利率因素，也反映市場對借款人信用風險的疑慮。
不過，Levitt並未將這些變化解讀為AI投資週期即將結束。他認為，市場對算力的需求依然強勁，更可能出現的情況是資本配置變得更加挑剔，投資人將更重視企業品質與資金運用效率。
他也指出，當槓桿與聯準會緊縮貨幣政策同時發揮作用，利率上升將推高融資成本並拖慢經濟活動。這不代表美股行情已經終結，但可能意味市場逐漸進入週期後段。
不過，他也強調，美股行情尚未結束，而且距離真正結束可能還有一段時間。

多空看法分歧　通膨與AI獲利成關鍵

近期機構對美股的不同判斷，主要圍繞美國經濟、AI資本支出與通膨風險三項變數。
美國就業數據維持強勁，使市場延後對聯準會降息的預期，高利率則持續對成長股估值形成壓力。
另一方面，AI資本支出已成為市場判斷行情能否延續的重要依據，投資人不再單純追逐AI概念，而是開始區分算力與晶片等上游投資，以及雲端業者和AI應用端能否實現獲利。
中東局勢推升油價，也加深通膨反彈疑慮，進一步限制聯準會的政策空間。
相較於美銀與貝萊德的謹慎立場，摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 資產管理與研究團隊仍對美股抱持建設性看法，認為美國經濟陷入衰退的風險較低，AI資本支出週期也仍在延續。
隨著AI投資的效益逐步擴散至雲端服務供應商等企業，獲利成長有望從算力上游擴大至其他領域。該行認為，這波行情主要由企業獲利帶動，而非單純依靠估值擴張，但市場走勢仍可能反覆震盪。
摩根士丹利則採取「建設性看多，但不能掉以輕心」的立場。該行認為，美股獲利仍具韌性，AI資本支出預期持續上修，工業、雲端大型企業、金融及非必需消費品等板塊相對具備優勢。
然而，摩根士丹利也將通膨反彈視為美股面臨的主要下行風險。若通膨再度升溫，聯準會可能被迫維持較緊縮的流動性政策，引發市場修正；地緣政治衝突推升油價，也可能衝擊企業獲利預期。
paras_en: US equities in October shifted to a more volatile pattern, with market focus moving from rising prices and valuations to whether corporate earnings can sustain the high‑level rally. As long‑term US Treasury yields stay elevated, oil prices rebound, stoking inflation concerns, and hedge funds trim AI tech stocks, the divide between bulls and bears widens, and Wall Street institutions are increasingly split on the outlook.
In early October the S&P 500 and Nasdaq briefly set new all‑time highs, but profit‑taking pressure soon intensified, increasing market volatility.

On October 23 all three major US indexes closed lower, with the Dow down 1.24%, the Nasdaq down 0.21% and the S&P 500 down 0.52%. Over the week the Dow rose 0.41% while the Nasdaq and S&P 500 fell 0.71% and 0.47% respectively.
Bank of America (BAC‑US) recently issued a strategy note warning of US equity risk and recommending reduced exposure to US stocks, with a shift toward defensive assets and high‑yield bonds.

The bank still projects an S&P 500 year‑end target of 7,400 points, but argues that valuations are already high, long‑term Treasury yields remain elevated, leaving little room for further valuation expansion, and earnings expectations are already priced in. A weaker earnings season could trigger valuation corrections.
BofA also cautioned that rising oil prices could reignite inflation, compressing the Federal Reserve’s room to cut rates and even raising the chance of another rate hike.
Although hedge funds have recently trimmed tech holdings, easing market congestion, investor sentiment remains fragile and short‑term trading risks in AI stocks should not be ignored.
BlackRock (BLK‑US) has lowered its tactical stance on US equities from “overweight” to “neutral,” yet it has not changed its long‑term optimism for the AI sector.

BlackRock believes AI infrastructure will remain a long‑term earnings driver for US companies. However, in an environment of higher rates and increasing US government financing pressure, investors must be more selective. Rising financing costs will widen performance gaps, and only firms that can sustain returns above those costs are likely to stay ahead.

In its asset allocation, BlackRock is modestly cutting US equity exposure and adding short‑term US Treasury positions; within US equities it continues to favor key AI bottlenecks such as chips, data centers, power infrastructure and listed infrastructure assets.
Invesco’s chief global market strategist Brian Levitt says the long‑term US rally may be slowing but is not yet over.

He warns that as a market cycle nears its end, warning signs often appear—rapid debt expansion, elevated inflation, overly tight monetary policy, widening credit spreads and sell‑offs in cyclical stocks. Some of these traits are already showing, and investors should stay vigilant.

Levitt highlights the growing reliance of AI infrastructure on debt financing. He notes that the bond market is now more rigorously differentiating borrower credit quality, and since June, widening credit spreads have accounted for roughly half of the increase in high‑yield financing costs, indicating that higher costs stem from both rates and credit risk concerns.

Nevertheless, Levitt does not see these shifts as signaling the end of the AI investment cycle. He believes demand for compute remains strong, and the likely outcome is more discerning capital allocation, with investors focusing on company quality and capital efficiency.

He adds that when leverage and the Fed’s tightening coincide, rising rates will lift financing costs and slow economic activity. This does not mean the US equity rally is over, but it may suggest the market is moving into the later stage of the cycle.
He stresses, however, that the US equity rally is far from finished and may still have considerable mileage left before it truly ends.
Diverging views among institutions center on three variables: the US economy, AI capital spending, and inflation risk.
Strong US employment data has pushed back expectations of Fed rate cuts, and high rates continue to pressure growth‑stock valuations.

Conversely, AI capital spending has become a key gauge of whether the rally can continue; investors are no longer chasing AI hype alone but are differentiating upstream investments such as compute and chips from cloud providers and AI application profitability.
Middle‑East tensions have lifted oil prices, deepening inflation‑rebound concerns and further limiting the Fed’s policy space.

In contrast to the cautious stances of BofA and BlackRock, JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) asset‑management and research teams remain constructive on US equities, seeing low recession risk for the US economy and an ongoing AI capital‑spending cycle.

As AI investment benefits spread to cloud service providers and other firms, earnings growth could expand from compute upstream to broader sectors. The bank views the rally as driven primarily by corporate earnings rather than pure valuation expansion, though market moves may still be choppy.

Morgan Stanley takes a “constructively bullish but cautious” view, believing US earnings remain resilient, AI cap‑ex expectations are being revised upward, and sectors such as industrials, large cloud firms, financials and discretionary goods have relative advantages.

However, Morgan Stanley also flags an inflation rebound as the main downside risk for US equities. A renewed inflation surge could force the Fed to maintain tighter liquidity, prompting a market correction; geopolitical conflicts that push oil higher could also hit earnings forecasts.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉中釉憑轉型新材料事業力拚轉機 周漲12.44%站回所有均線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Zhongyou (1809-TW) Pursues Turnaround via New Materials Business, Rises 12.44% This Week and Reclaims All Moving Averages
paras: 中釉(1809-TW)近年積極轉型，旗下新材料事業中的螢光玻璃片新品效益持續擴大，成為營運助力，大盤上周跌破5日線，中釉卻在成交量爆量衝上5.1萬張挹注下，周漲12.44%，股價收47元，站上所有均線，周K收紅。
中釉產品線近年因AI崛起，新產品布局積極，由傳統磁磚與釉料製造持續轉型為新材料，今(2026)年從玻璃與陶瓷專業技術出發，除了跨足半導體關鍵材料領域，也在類晶玻璃陶瓷基板技術上取得突破性進展。
法人表示，中釉近年除了轉型研發高附加價值的「螢光玻璃片」與「電子陶瓷材料」，也成功打入LED與車用光電封裝應用，投入固態電池電解質隔離膜材料，讓轉型題材也成為市場追逐熱點。
在營運層面上，中釉上(9)月營收年增5.88%、月增 7.68%，單月營收創近 8 個月新高，近期訂單動能有穩定成長跡象，投資人後續可關注中釉在汽車螢光玻璃片、陶瓷基板與半導體材料等新產品線的放量進度，以及營收能否延續穩定年增與高階材料占比提升。
中釉目前旗下有三大事業，包括陶瓷事業部、建築材料事業部、新材料事業部；其中最受矚的是新材料事業，包括螢光玻璃片、低介電類晶玻璃陶瓷基板、固態電池用電解質隔離膜材料等三大產品線。
paras_en: Zhongyou (1809‑TW) has been actively transforming in recent years, and the new fluorescent glass sheet product in its new‑materials division continues to expand its benefits, becoming an operational boost. While the broader market fell below the 5‑day moving average last week, Zhongyou surged on a massive volume of 51,000 shares, gaining 12.44% for the week and closing at NT$47, above all moving averages, with a red weekly candlestick.

In recent years, driven by the rise of AI, Zhongyou’s product strategy has shifted aggressively from traditional tiles and glazes toward new materials. Starting in 2026, leveraging its glass and ceramic expertise, the company not only entered the semiconductor key‑materials arena but also achieved breakthrough progress in quasi‑crystalline glass‑ceramic substrate technology.

Institutional investors note that Zhongyou has, beyond developing high‑value‑added “fluorescent glass sheets” and “electronic ceramic materials,” successfully entered LED and automotive optoelectronic packaging markets, and is investing in solid‑state battery electrolyte separator materials, turning its transformation theme into a market‑hot topic.

On the operational side, Zhongyou’s revenue in September rose 5.88% year‑over‑year and 7.68% month‑over‑month, setting a near‑eight‑month high for a single month. Recent order flow shows steady growth, and investors can watch the scaling of new product lines such as automotive fluorescent glass sheets, ceramic substrates, and semiconductor materials, as well as whether revenue can maintain stable year‑over‑year growth and an increasing share of high‑end materials.

Zhongyou currently operates three major divisions: the Ceramic Division, the Building Materials Division, and the New Materials Division. The most watched is the New Materials Division, which includes three product lines: fluorescent glass sheets, low‑dielectric quasi‑crystalline glass‑ceramic substrates, and electrolyte separator membranes for solid‑state batteries.

items.title: iPhone Duo螢幕出包 鴻海人士：實際生產未受影響
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Screen Defect, Foxconn Staff: Actual Production Unaffected
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首部摺疊機iPhone Duo開售首周，就有果粉反應螢幕故障的問題。
目前傳播較為廣泛的兩個案例，一台來自中國上海陸家嘴國金中心Apple Store零售店，一台由一名澳洲用戶在Reddit平台上發帖。此外，還有少數用戶在社交平台上發帖，引起不小聲量。
消費者之間的使用情況和螢幕損壞程度有細微區別，但相對一致的是，iPhone Duo摺疊次數不多，在幾次到幾十次，在最後一次展開後，摺疊處出現異響，隨即下方出現3至5釐米長裂痕，螢幕右方與該裂痕頂點垂直處也出現裂痕。兩處裂痕呈白色像素帶狀，交點附近有不同大小黑斑。
問題可能出在iPhone Duo鉸鏈上。
iFixit發布的iPhone Duo拆解報告，針對近期消費者出現的螢幕故障問題做推測，原因可能在於手機閉合時中央支撐桿未能正確縮回，從而對螢幕施加過大壓力。
另外，引導鉸鏈運動的弧形導軌，在摺疊過程中會高於周圍組件，如果導軌未能按預期移動，也存在干擾螢幕的可能性。
據《界面新聞》26日（周一）報導，一名鴻海(2317-TW) 員工說，此次螢幕障礙原因與上述分析大致相近。
該鴻海員工還表示，在產能吃緊的狀態下，蘋果曾降低過一定良率質檢標準，以保證供應，這必然導致螢幕故障產品流入市場的機率變高。
儘管蘋果採取了小幅放寬標準的舉措，但從實際影響看來，iPhone Duo螢幕故障的機率沒想像中那麼高。經銷商稱，手機出現問題的頻率不高，暫未遇到售後問題。
在最新舉措上，前述鴻海人士表示，針對相關問題，iPhone Duo產線已緊急替換一批物料，目前實際生產未受影響，也暫未改變備貨策略。渠道人士表示，iPhone Duo今年備貨將在750萬台量級。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) saw reports of screen failures from fans within the first week of sales of its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.

Two widely reported cases involve a unit from the Apple Store in Lujiazui, Shanghai, China, and another posted by an Australian user on Reddit, with a few other users also posting on social platforms, generating noticeable buzz.

Consumers reported slightly different usage patterns and damage extents, but consistently the iPhone Duo was folded only a few to a few dozen times; after the final opening a strange noise was heard at the hinge and a 3‑to‑5 cm crack appeared below, with a second crack vertically aligned with the tip of the first on the right side of the screen. Both cracks formed white pixel‑like bands and black spots of varying sizes near the intersection.
The problem may lie in the iPhone Duo’s hinge.

iFixit’s teardown report on the iPhone Duo, speculating on recent consumer‑reported screen failures, suggests the central support rod may not retract properly when the phone closes, applying excessive pressure to the display.
Additionally, the curved guide rail that directs hinge movement sits higher than surrounding components during folding; if the rail does not move as expected, it could also interfere with the screen.
According to a Monday, 26th report by Interface News, a Foxconn (2317‑TW) employee said the screen issue’s cause is broadly consistent with the above analyses.

The Foxconn employee added that, under tight capacity constraints, Apple had lowered certain yield quality‑control standards to ensure supply, which inevitably raises the likelihood of defective screens reaching the market.

Although Apple made a modest relaxation of standards, the actual incidence of iPhone Duo screen failures is not as high as imagined; dealers say problems are infrequent and no after‑sales issues have surfaced yet.

The Foxconn source said that, in response to the issue, the iPhone Duo production line has urgently swapped a batch of components, so current manufacturing is unaffected and inventory strategy remains unchanged. Channel sources say this year’s iPhone Duo stock will be around 7.5 million units.
