items.title: 看好Claude也不急著買！華爾街為Anthropic上市算三筆帳
items.title_en: Optimistic About Claude Yet Not Rushing to Buy! Wall Street Counts Three Angles on Anthropic's IPO
paras: Anthropic公開上市申請文件，為AI投資熱潮帶來新的信心測試。華爾街投資人士認為，這場IPO將成為頂尖AI模型開發商的估值指標，但看好技術前景，不代表願意在上市時買進。估值是否合理、巨額募資會否排擠其他科技股資金，以及企業需求能否支撐長期投入，正成為市場關注焦點。
Anthropic遞件消息一度提振美股期指，標普500指數周一(26日)早盤上漲0.5%。不過，受訪人士對上市後的表現看法分歧，有人視為AI行情仍具活力的證明，也有人認為，投資人日後可能等到更好的進場價格。

看好AI不等於追IPO 投資人不願再開空白支票

Cresalta Investment Management投資長Josh Stevens表示，他對AI技術抱持樂觀，也認為Anthropic令人期待，但不會急著在IPO時買進。即使是優秀的構想或商業模式，在市場重新評估供需時，股價仍可能回落至更具吸引力的水準，屆時才是進場機會。
Great Hill Capital董事長Thomas Hayes則認為，約1.5兆美元的估值偏高，這場發行更適合深信公司終將帶來投資回報的人。他指出，短期股價可能因發行股票供給受控而上漲，但長期仍須由經營成果支撐，在公司扭轉虧損之前，投資人可能有機會以低於IPO的價格買進。
Hayes對估值的質疑部分建立在巨額淨損之上。不過，依先前揭露的財務資料，Anthropic上半年807億美元淨損主要受到可轉換債券公允價值上升影響，同期營業虧損為6.93億美元，不能將淨損直接視為營運現金消耗。
Renaissance Capital資深策略師Matt Kennedy表示，幾個月前，投資人還不會如此嚴格質疑估值，如今部分夏季熱門AI新股已跌破發行價，即使是Anthropic，也拿不到市場的「空白支票」。

與Meta募資同場競逐 小型AI股恐受資金排擠

除了定價，Anthropic上市也可能牽動既有科技股的資金流向。Hayes指出，若投資人賣出科技七巨頭中的大型雲端業者股票，籌錢參與Anthropic IPO，未來幾周可能對這些股票構成壓力。
他認為，影響程度將取決於微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)本周財報表現，這些公司的業績與展望，將左右投資人是否繼續持有，或轉而布局新上市的AI公司。
Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry則提醒，Meta(META-US)也宣布計劃透過股權發行籌資最多950億美元，兩大募資案可能同時吸收大量市場資金。
Mulberry認為，當大型業者競相籌資，規模較小、甚至品質較差的AI公司可能受到不利影響。Anthropic上市即使成功，也不代表資金會平均流向整個AI產業。
IPOX Schuster分析師Lukas Muehlbauer同樣指出，投資人仍會區分已有客戶需求驗證的業務，以及主要依賴未來成長預期支撐的支出計畫，因此這場IPO的好處不會由所有AI企業平等分享。

上市成敗牽動產業信心 AI估值將有新標竿

Andersen Capital Management創辦人Peter Andersen認為，Anthropic上市是AI發展的重要里程碑，結果將反映投資人是否願意繼續支持AI開發所需的資本支出。
Muehlbauer則表示，這場IPO將為領先AI實驗室建立估值標竿，影響後續上市案，也牽動市場對資助AI基礎設施建設企業的信心。
Ingenium Analytics管理合夥人Andre Bakhos較為樂觀，認為此案顯示AI交易熱潮仍有活力，AI應用滲透將持續，也有助提振同業投資情緒。不過，他強調，這也是一場資金競賽，估值與成長能持續多久的問題不會消失。
Dakota Wealth資深投資組合經理Robert Pavlik則認為，上市環境充滿挑戰，成敗不僅關係Anthropic，也牽動整個AI產業。若發行順利，可能重建投資人信心，但公司需要提出足以吸引市場的承諾，而這些承諾能否在短期內兌現，仍有疑問。
Kennedy另指出，上市對Anthropic也有策略意義。公司採公益公司(PBC)架構，成為上市公司將帶來更高程度的公開透明度，讓市場能持續檢視其營運與財務表現。
paras_en: Anthropic has filed its IPO registration, providing a new confidence test amid the AI investment boom. Wall Street investors see the offering as a valuation benchmark for top AI model developers, but liking the technology’s prospects does not mean they are willing to buy at the listing. Questions about whether the valuation is reasonable, whether the massive fundraising will crowd out other tech stocks, and whether corporate demand can sustain long‑term investment are becoming market focal points.

Anthropic’s filing briefly lifted U.S. equity futures, with the S&P 500 up 0.5% in early trade on Monday the 26th. Yet interviewees are split on post‑IPO performance: some view it as proof that AI momentum remains strong, while others think investors may wait for a better entry price later.

Being bullish on AI does not equal chasing the IPO; investors are unwilling to write blank checks. Josh Stevens, CIO of Cresalta Investment Management, said he is optimistic about AI and finds Anthropic exciting, but he won’t rush to buy at the IPO. Even a great idea or business model can see its stock fall back to a more attractive level when the market re‑evaluates supply and demand, and that would be the real entry point.

Thomas Hayes, chairman of Great Hill Capital, believes a roughly $1.5 trillion valuation is too high and the offering suits those who are convinced the company will eventually deliver returns. He noted that short‑term share price may rise because the stock supply is controlled, but long‑term performance must be backed by operating results, and investors could have a chance to buy below the IPO price before the company turns profitable.

Hayes’s valuation concerns stem partly from the huge net loss. However, according to previously disclosed financials, Anthropic’s H1 net loss of $80.7 billion was mainly driven by a rise in the fair value of convertible bonds, while operating loss for the period was $693 million, so the net loss should not be taken as a direct cash‑burn indicator.

Matt Kennedy, senior strategist at Renaissance Capital, said that a few months ago investors would not have scrutinized the valuation so tightly. Now several summer‑hot AI IPOs have already fallen below their issue prices, and even Anthropic cannot expect a market “blank check.”

Competing with Meta for fundraising, small AI stocks may be squeezed. In addition to pricing, Anthropic’s listing could shift capital away from existing tech stocks. Hayes pointed out that if investors sell shares of the big seven tech cloud players to fund the Anthropic IPO, those stocks could feel pressure in the coming weeks.

He added that the impact will depend on this week’s earnings from Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US). Those companies’ results and outlooks will dictate whether investors stay put or reallocate to the newly listed AI firm.

Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, warned that Meta (META‑US) also announced plans to raise up to $95 billion through an equity offering, meaning the two large fundraising efforts could soak up a lot of market capital at the same time.

Mulberry argued that when big players race to raise money, smaller or lower‑quality AI companies may suffer. Even if Anthropic’s IPO succeeds, it does not guarantee that capital will flow evenly across the AI sector.

Lukas Muehlbauer, analyst at IPOX Schuster, likewise noted that investors will still differentiate between businesses with verified customer demand and those whose spending plans rely mainly on future growth expectations, so the benefits of this IPO will not be shared equally by all AI firms.

The IPO’s success or failure will affect industry confidence, creating a new benchmark for AI valuations. Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management, said Anthropic’s listing is a key milestone for AI development, and the outcome will reflect whether investors are willing to keep funding the capital‑intensive AI pipeline.
Muehlbauer added that the offering will set a valuation benchmark for leading AI labs, influencing subsequent listings and shaping market confidence in funding AI infrastructure companies.

Andre Bakhos, managing partner at Ingenium Analytics, is relatively upbeat, seeing the deal as evidence that AI trading enthusiasm remains strong, that AI adoption will continue, and that it could boost peer investment sentiment. He cautioned, however, that this is also a capital race, and questions about how long valuations and growth can be sustained will not disappear.

Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth, said the listing environment is challenging and the outcome matters not only for Anthropic but for the whole AI industry. A smooth offering could rebuild investor confidence, but the company must make market‑appealing commitments, and there is doubt whether those promises can be delivered in the short term.

Kennedy also pointed out that the IPO has strategic significance for Anthropic. The company’s public‑benefit corporation (PBC) structure means that becoming a listed company will increase transparency, allowing the market to continuously monitor its operations and financial performance.

items.title: 十月累漲4.6%！瑞士股市成為市場AI恐慌下的避風港
items.title_en: October Up 4.6%: Swiss Market Becomes a Safe Haven Amid AI Panic
paras: 瑞士股指本月迄今累計上漲4.6%，而歐元區大盤指數歐洲Stoxx 50同期跌幅則達3.2%，兩者近8個百分點的超額收益創2020年3月以來最高。這一反差背後是歐洲投資人在融資成本走高、AI交易遇冷及法西政局動盪之際，主動降低風險敞口，轉向防禦資產。
上漲幾乎全由三大權重股拉動：羅氏漲12%、諾華漲6.7%、雀巢漲10%，這三檔老牌防禦龍頭貢獻指數全部漲幅，合計佔指數近半權重。
EFG資產管理指出，資金正從擁擠的AI交易撤出，回流獲利紮實、對利率敏感度低的醫藥與食品部門。美銀調查也顯示，淨16%的基金經理人最看好瑞士股市。
支撐行情的還有獲利預期改善。根據《彭博資訊》數據顯示，成分企業2027年獲利成長預期上升至10%，幾乎今年兩倍。
瑞士知名私人銀行薩夫拉薩辛銀行策略師Wolf von Rotberg上調評級至「跑贏大盤」，稱利率、美元及宏觀週期見頂三大因素均利好瑞士市場。
但估值隱憂浮現。經過一輪急漲，瑞士股指相對Stoxx 50的比價重回近兩年高位，估值偏貴限制上行空間。
此外，瑞士法郎本月因避險需求反彈，恐擾動出口導向大盤股獲利。市場正權衡防禦屬性與高估值壓力，修復行情能否延續仍待觀察。
paras_en: Swiss equities have risen 4.6% so far this month, while the Euro‑zone’s broad Stoxx 50 index has fallen 3.2% over the same period, delivering an excess return of nearly eight percentage points – the widest gap since March 2020. The divergence reflects European investors trimming risk exposure as financing costs rise, AI‑driven trading cools, and political turmoil spikes, prompting a shift toward defensive assets.

The gains are almost entirely driven by three heavyweight stocks: Roche up 12%, Novartis up 6.7% and Nestlé up 10%. These three long‑standing defensive leaders account for almost half of the index’s weight and contributed the full upside of the index.

EFG Asset Management notes that capital is flowing out of crowded AI trades and back into solid‑earning, low‑rate‑sensitivity sectors such as pharmaceuticals and food. A Bank of America survey also shows that a net 16% of fund managers are most bullish on Swiss equities.

The rally is also supported by improving earnings expectations. Bloomberg data indicate that the component companies’ profit‑growth outlook for 2027 has risen to 10%, roughly double the forecast made earlier this year.

Wolf von Rotberg, a strategist at Swiss private bank Safra Sarasin, upgraded his rating to “outperform,” saying that peaking interest rates, a strong dollar and a top‑of‑the‑cycle macro environment are all favorable for the Swiss market.

However, valuation concerns are emerging. After a sharp rally, the Swiss index’s price‑to‑Stoxx 50 multiple has returned to near‑two‑year highs, making the market look expensive and capping further upside potential.

In addition, the Swiss franc has rebounded this month on safe‑haven demand, which could hurt profit margins of export‑oriented large‑cap stocks. The market is weighing defensive appeal against overvaluation pressure, and it remains to be seen whether the rally can be sustained.

paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。
英鎊兌美元升值0.05%，至1.3401美元。
澳幣兌美元則下跌0.11%，至0.7019美元。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

items.title: 【遠東商銀】RBA立場鷹派，激勵澳幣上漲
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: RBA’s Hawkish Stance Fuels Aussie Dollar Rise
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月獨棟住宅建設大幅下滑及未來建設指標建築許可降至三年半低點，並據多名伊朗官員表示有意拖延與美國談判，試圖削弱美國總統川普在11月期中選舉選情，而且美國公債收益率下滑，削減美元吸引力，週三令美元承壓；此外，路透調查顯示，多數經濟學家預計日本央行(BOJ)在12月上調利率至1.50%及維持每季升息一次的節奏，而且日本政府公布9月進、出口分別較上年同期增長18.9%和16.7%低於預期，但得益於半導體和人工智能(AI)相關產品需求強勁，出口連續十三個月實現增長，貿易逆差則縮窄至5,366億日圓，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月指出，進口成本上升推動日本經濟面臨物價上漲，且即將進入由工資上漲驅動的持續通貨膨脹時期，政府將與BOJ保持密切溝通，雙方在通貨膨脹前景與政策方面無重大分歧，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.39高點下滑。

隨著日本長期公債收益率延續漲勢，正吸引日本資本加劇回流，並據BOJ副總裁冰見野良三表示，燃料和原材料價格上漲推高物價，且全球AI需求旺盛對物價形成上行壓力，認為日本基礎通貨膨脹率已相當接近央行的2%目標，表明BOJ已準備好上調借貸成本，擴大美元兌日圓跌幅至157.82低點，但美國和以色列與伊朗之間的衝突加劇，市場波動性上升及引發對能源供應中斷的擔憂，而且美國原油燃料庫存下降提供額外支持，國際原油價格上漲，限制美元走低。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.20-40，支撐於157.30-50。

U.S. September single‑family home construction fell sharply and future construction permits dropped to a three‑and‑a‑half‑year low. Multiple Iranian officials say they intend to delay talks with the United States to weaken President Trump’s prospects in the November mid‑term elections. Meanwhile U.S. Treasury yields fell, reducing the dollar’s appeal and putting pressure on the greenback on Wednesday. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates to 1.50% in December and keep a quarterly‑hike rhythm. Japan’s government reported September imports and exports grew 18.9% and 16.7% year‑on‑year, respectively, below expectations, but strong demand for semiconductor and AI‑related products kept exports up for a 13th consecutive month while the trade deficit narrowed to ¥536.6 billion. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki noted rising import costs are pushing Japanese prices higher and that the economy is entering a wage‑driven, sustained inflation phase. The government will stay in close contact with the BOJ, and both sides see no major disagreement on inflation outlook or policy, supporting yen gains as the USD/JPY pair fell from its ¥158.39 high.

As long‑term Japanese government bond yields continue to rise, they are attracting capital back to Japan. BOJ Deputy Governor Masayoshi Amamiya said higher fuel and raw‑material prices are lifting inflation, and robust global AI demand adds upward pressure on prices. He believes Japan’s core inflation is now close to the BOJ’s 2% target, indicating the central bank is ready to raise borrowing costs, widening the USD/JPY decline to a ¥157.82 low. However, escalating conflict between the United States, Israel and Iran is raising market volatility and fears of energy‑supply disruptions, while falling U.S. crude inventories are supporting higher oil prices, limiting the dollar’s fall. The pair’s resistance is projected at 158.20‑40 and support at 157.30‑50 today.
EUR/USD

RBA Deputy Governor Guy Debelle said yesterday that monetary tightening is slowing the Australian economy, but high oil prices are worsening inflation, leaving him uncertain whether another rate hike will be needed next month. The market now sees roughly a 50% chance of an RBA hike in November, pushing the Aussie dollar to a three‑week high and lifting the euro‑dollar pair from its ¥1.1211 low.

French 10‑year bond yields have risen to their highest level since 2002, highlighting concerns that widespread protests are worsening France’s fiscal fragility and political uncertainty. ECB chief economist Philip Lane said the ECB can bolster the euro’s global standing and expand its policy influence by offering liquidity backstops to foreign markets, helping the euro‑dollar pair reach a ¥1.1240 peak. The euro is expected to find support at 1.1200‑20 and face resistance at 1.1280‑1.1300 today.

This clouds Chancellor Jeremy Hunt’s first budget slated for next week and drags the pound down to a ¥1.3361 low against the dollar. Subsequent UK data showed August house prices rose 0.9% year‑on‑year, the weakest since March, while the Iran‑related war drove energy prices higher. paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。
歐元兌美元上漲0.01%，至1.1237美元。
法國大規模反政府抗議活動，以及日益惡化的財政前景，持續對歐元造成壓力。法國10年期公債借貸成本週三升至24年來高點。
Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。
其他貨幣方面，澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁Andrew Hauser在花旗集團一場會議上表示，通膨前景「明顯惡化」，帶動澳幣走強。
澳幣兌美元上漲0.41%，至0.7031美元。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.16%，至1.34美元。數據顯示，英國9月通膨升幅高於預期，進一步強化了英格蘭銀行(BoE)11月升息的理由。
英鎊兌歐元則升至17個月來最高水準。
日元兌美元上漲0.02%，至158.12日元。日本央行(BoJ)副總裁冰見野良三(Ryozo Himino)表示，日本潛在通膨已接近央行2%的目標，金融環境仍寬鬆，暗示未來仍有提高借貸成本的空間。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.
